answer_1.quote: we introduce CARD, a cross-modal agent-driven framework that leverages natural language input to generate and edit 3D residential designs.
answer_1.outputs: Residential floor plan images and 3D representations

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics: To compare generated residential floor plans, we used the FID, PSNR, and SSIM metrics.

answer_3.quote: We use a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) method to allow the auditor to retrieve relevant regulatory information from a pre-built database and generate context-aware evaluations.

answer_4.quote: Finally, we used experts and ordinary users to comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of the model generation.
answer_4.guideline: Experts and users identified authentic floor plans in a mixed set of real and generated images, and scored consistency and rationality based on predefined scales.
